title: SC01-T3 — the toast (SH05, SH06, SH07)
line: Greg. Sit down. / Paula's the same age as you. Exact same. Look at her, then look at you. Just ask her what she does. That's all I'm saying. / Paula's the same age as you. Exact same. Look at her, then look at you. Just ask her what she does. That's all I'm saying.
motionPlan: Susan, without moving her body, says it low to him → Greg's loose hand enters frame edge pointing across at her; Paula keeps her eyes on her plate → Susan absolutely still, eyes level, breathing once
note: Waits for its ingredients' Confirm (the voice masters and the cake card), then one Seedance call (§24K part 5).
